ety.text: Inherited from Old Hindi में (meṃ), महिं (mahiṃ), महि (mahi). Ultimately from Sanskrit मध्ये॑ (mádhye), the locative of मध्य॑ (mádhya, “inside”), either via unstressed lenition to *महे (mahe) < *मझे (majhe) < Prakrit मज्झे (majjhe) or from Prakrit *महिए (mahie) < मध्ये (mádhiye), a glide-vocalized variant.
